_comment: 'When this attacks a hero, YOU MAY wager a Gold, Might, and Vigor token with them.' Two clauses were missing. WAGER read only the singular 'prize'/'token', so the 'tokens' list was dropped and the card wagered prize None -- CR 8.5.46b's 'no prize specified' case, where the winner is considered to have won and receives nothing. WAGER now takes a list, which is three wagers on one attack (combat.wagers is a list and a wager has one prize); they resolve together because they hang on the same attack hitting. The 'you may' was absent too, so the wager was mandatory.
